item.title: Hawas Chrome by Rasasi – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Xerjoff Erba Pura
Type:
Price: 2.49

Overview

Fruity, bright, and modern, Hawas Chrome by Rasasi is a fresh fruity-amber fragrance that blends juicy yellow fruits, smooth peach, citrus, tropical fruits, warm amber, vanilla, and musk into a sweet and vibrant composition. It opens with a lively combination of yellow fruits, peach, and orange, creating a bright fruity-citrus introduction with a smooth tropical sweetness. As the fragrance develops, watery fruits, mango, and passion fruit add a juicy exotic character before settling into a warm base of amber, vanilla, and musk.

Hawas Chrome delivers a sweet, fruity, and ambery scent profile with a modern tropical edge, making it a strong choice for anyone who enjoys bright, attention-grabbing fragrances with a smooth warm finish.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Yellow Fruits, Peach, Orange

Middle: Watery Fruits, Mango, Passion Fruit

Base: Amber, Vanilla, Musk

Inspired & Occasion

Hawas Chrome is part of Rasasi’s Hawas collection and is described by fragrance sources as a 2026 fruity amber release built around yellow fruits, peach, orange, watery fruits, mango, passion fruit, amber, vanilla, and musk. iFragrance also lists it as being compared to the sweet fruity amber style of Xerjoff Erba Pura.

Perfect for:

Daily wear
Spring & summer
Warm weather
Vacation wear
Casual outings
Night outings
Fans of fruity amber fragrances
Fans of mango, peach, vanilla, and musk scents

Try Before You Commit

Hawas Chrome opens with a bright burst of yellow fruits, peach, and orange, giving the fragrance a juicy, sweet, and energetic first impression. As it settles, watery fruits, mango, and passion fruit create a tropical heart that feels fresh, smooth, and vibrant. The dry down introduces amber, vanilla, and musk, adding warmth, sweetness, and a clean musky finish that helps round out the fruitiness. If you enjoy bold fruity fragrances with tropical sweetness and a warm amber-vanilla base, Hawas Chrome is a great fragrance to sample before committing to a full bottle.
